issue_context.title: Revoke role from current_user results error.
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
```sql
create role r1;
grant r1 to current_user();
revoke r1 from current_user();
drop role r1;
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
```sql
mysql> create role r1;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)

mysql> grant r1 to current_user();
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> revoke r1 from current_user();
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> drop role r1;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)
```
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```sql
mysql> create role r1;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)

mysql> grant r1 to current_user();
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql> revoke r1 from current_user();
ERROR 1396 (HY000): Operation REVOKE ROLE failed for @
mysql> drop role r1;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)
```
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
```sql
| Release Version: v6.0.0-alpha-62-g15ddcd085
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 15ddcd085a8be0f97c1b5ce1e5397369c3061372
Git Branch: master
UTC Build Time: 2022-03-15 15:49:18
GoVersion: go1.17.2
Race Enabled: false
TiKV Min Version: v3.0.0-60965b006877ca7234adaced7890d7b029ed1306
Check Table Before Drop: false |
```

review_comments:
Do you want to find the current user and set it with current session?
Why not break if find it?
In order to prevent an error when calling current_user multiple times, such as "revoke 'r1' from current_user(),current_user() ;" . Test cases for this scenario have been added.
